name: Joshikousei Mana no Nakadashi Game
original_name: 女子校生真菜の中出しGAME
source:
One day, Mana's father suddenly tells her to marry Hitoshi, a sick-room teacher. Mana is happy, but confused.... Hitoshi is confused as well... "You don't wanna marry me...?" Mana gets mad and makes up her mind to approach Hitoshi. Also, Yurika, a science teacher, also starts approaching Hitoshi... Well, will Mana be able to win his heart...?

[From ErogeShop]
